name: Aggregation sums the wrong field
modeled_on: A revenue rollup sums `units` where it should sum `amount` — a wrong-field aggregation that produces plausible-but-wrong numbers. Real-world analogue: analytics pipelines silently reporting the wrong metric because one mapping key was swapped.
hidden_bug: revenue_by_region() adds `s["units"]` to the running total instead of `s["amount"]`, so revenue figures are wrong.
expected_behavior: revenue_by_region() must sum the amount per region, not the unit count.

expected_patch.description: sum the amount field instead of units
